simple.summary: אִי־כָבוֹד (ʼÎy-kâbôwd) means Ikabod , a son of Phineas First listed occurrence: 1Sam 4 21.

definitions.full: H350. I -kabod כָבוֺד אִי ( 1Sam 4:21 ), אִיכָֿבוֺד ( 14:3 ) proper name, masculine ( inglorious ), son of Phinehas (explained 4:21 by מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל כָבוֺד גָּלָה glory is gone into exile from Israel .
